result.brief: 提出 Fréchet Forcing：用自生成历史加真实数据锚定、潜空间 Fréchet 距离保持场景保真、真实帧分布匹配保持真实感，无需教师模型或长视频即可微调动作条件流式世界模型，实现超 4000 帧稳定长程 rollout。
result.reason: Proposes Fréchet Forcing, a training method for action-conditioned streaming video world models that stabilizes long-horizon rollouts using latent-statistics distribution matching on short clips.
